t: Scrubb heavy duty beaded hand cleaner provides a powerful solution for effective degreasing and removing stubborn dirt, oil, and grease from hands. Engineered for trade professionals working in workshops, garages, and on factory floors, this industrial-strength hand cleanser incorporates natural scrubbing agents and an orange scrub gritted formula for deep cleaning action. While robustly tackling tough residues, the formulation is kind to skin, leaving hands feeling clean and hydrated with a refreshing orange fragrance. The convenient 100ml size ensures it is readily available for use whenever needed.
b: Leaves Hands With Refreshing Orange Scent
